patterns.name: Infest a vehicle
patterns.summary: Latch onto or into an enemy vehicle and work on it until removed.

patterns.name: Leech the weapon of what you destroy
patterns.summary: Gain a weapon or upgrade from an enemy that dies while you claim it.

patterns.name: A weapon that changes with the passenger
patterns.summary: A vehicle's weapon or job is set by whoever rides inside.

patterns.name: Disable a machine
patterns.summary: Pin or shut down a vehicle or drone with an electric or EMP effect.

patterns.name: Deploy into siege mode
patterns.summary: Stop and anchor to gain a stronger stationary mode; pack up to move again.

patterns.name: Transform between two forms
patterns.summary: Switch between two forms, such as walker and jet, each with its own movement and weapons.

patterns.name: Disguise
patterns.summary: Look like something else (a friendly unit, a prop) until you act or are found out.

patterns.name: Garrison or transport
patterns.summary: Carry teammates inside a vehicle or building, protected, and let them out or fight from it where needed.

patterns.name: A shield that absorbs damage
patterns.summary: Switch on or project a shield that soaks damage for a time.

patterns.name: Switch weapon mode
patterns.summary: Swap between two weapons or fire modes with one key.

patterns.name: Drain health
patterns.summary: A beam or attack that heals you by the damage it deals.

patterns.name: Hijack a vehicle
patterns.summary: Take over an enemy vehicle by throwing out or killing its crew.

patterns.name: Take control
patterns.summary: Control an enemy unit or its weapon for a short time.

patterns.name: Leap
patterns.summary: Jump over walls and gaps on a cooldown.

patterns.name: Dash
patterns.summary: A short burst of speed.

patterns.name: Burrow or submerge
patterns.summary: Hide underground or underwater, surfacing to act.

patterns.name: Teleport
patterns.summary: Blink a short distance or jump through space.

patterns.name: Cloak
patterns.summary: Turn invisible until you attack or are detected.

patterns.name: Mark a target
patterns.summary: Tag an enemy so the team sees it and hits it harder.

patterns.name: Freeze and shatter
patterns.summary: Slow, then freeze a target; the next hit on a frozen target does heavy damage.

patterns.name: Draw fire
patterns.summary: Pull enemy shots onto yourself to protect allies, trading firepower for armour.

patterns.name: Brace
patterns.summary: Trade speed or firepower for a short burst of damage reduction.

patterns.name: Invulnerability window
patterns.summary: Make yourself or allies immune to damage for a moment, at a cost.

patterns.name: Deploy a turret
patterns.summary: Place an automatic turret or device that fights on its own.

patterns.name: Repair and heal allies
patterns.summary: Repair vehicles or heal soldiers in the field.

patterns.name: Self-destruct
patterns.summary: Blow yourself up to damage everything nearby.

patterns.name: Recover a wreck
patterns.summary: Bring a destroyed or abandoned vehicle back into the fight on your side.

patterns.name: Capture or sabotage a structure
patterns.summary: Reach an enemy building, emplacement or point and take it over, or sabotage it from inside.

patterns.name: Host a spawn point
patterns.summary: Let teammates respawn at or inside you, usually once you deploy somewhere safe.

patterns.name: Overclock yourself
patterns.summary: Enter a short boosted state with more speed, fire rate or damage, paid for in health, heat or a slump afterwards.

patterns.name: Launch drones
patterns.summary: Release small drones or minions that fight around you and come back or expire.

patterns.name: Reinforce a squad
patterns.summary: Replace lost squad members in the field, near a teammate, a vehicle or a point.

patterns.name: Lay smoke
patterns.summary: Fill an area with smoke that blocks sight and aim for a short time.

patterns.name: Spawn a decoy
patterns.summary: Create fake units or buildings that draw fire and hide where the real ones are.

patterns.name: Jam sensors
patterns.summary: Block enemy radar, minimap pings or lock-ons around you, or break a lock already made.

patterns.name: Pull a target
patterns.summary: Hook, lift or drag an enemy toward you or out of position.

patterns.name: Suppress with fire
patterns.summary: Keep firing at an area so enemies there slow down and aim badly, and are pinned if it goes on.

patterns.name: Lock in stasis
patterns.summary: Trap a target out of time: it can't act or be hurt until the stasis ends.

patterns.name: Heal yourself
patterns.summary: Repair or heal yourself on a key, often while standing still or out of combat.

patterns.name: Reveal an area
patterns.summary: Scan or watch an area so hidden, cloaked or burrowed enemies there show up for the team.

patterns.name: Resupply allies
patterns.summary: Refill teammates' ammo, energy or ability charges from a pack, crate or vehicle.

patterns.name: Rally allies
patterns.summary: Boost nearby teammates' fire rate, accuracy, speed or armour with an aura or a timed call.

patterns.name: Gather resources
patterns.summary: Collect ore, scrap or wrecks and bring them back to earn money for the team.

patterns.name: Lay mines
patterns.summary: Plant hidden mines that hurt or stop the first enemy to touch them.

patterns.name: Leave a hazard zone
patterns.summary: Cover ground with fire, gas, radiation or a slowing field that hurts or hampers whoever stays in it.

patterns.name: Build cover
patterns.summary: Put up sandbags, wire, tank traps or walls that block shots or movement until destroyed.

patterns.name: Bombard an area
patterns.summary: Pick a spot; after a visible warning, shells, missiles or an air strike hit everything there.

patterns.name: Drop in from above
patterns.summary: Arrive by pod, parachute or drop ship on a spot you choose, with a warning where you will land.

patterns.name: Earn veterancy
patterns.summary: Gain ranks from kills or damage that make you tougher or deadlier until you die.

patterns.name: Upgrade in the field
patterns.summary: Spend resources during a life to add a weapon, module or armour to your current unit.

patterns.name: Throw an explosive
patterns.summary: Throw or plant a grenade, satchel or sticky charge on a cooldown to flush out or blow up a target.

patterns.name: Fire a power shot
patterns.summary: Fire one heavy special shot on a cooldown, often after a visible wind-up or by spending stored energy.
